title: HttpConfig
description:
Options for creating a gRPC client.

Deserializable but deliberately not serializable: the proxy password is a secret, and a type
that cannot be written out cannot leak it through a configuration dump. `Debug` redacts it for
the same reason.

Every option is spelled the way its own documentation names it (`Endpoint`, `TcpKeepalive`,
...), an empty string reads as the option's default, and a `serde` source may hand a bare
number or boolean over in its own type rather than as text.

AllowUnsafeConnection.description:
Accept any server certificate instead of verifying it: `1`, `true`, `yes`, `enable`,
`allow` or `authorize`, and their negatives; empty for false.

BackOffMultiplier.description: What each wait is multiplied by; empty for the default.

CaCert.description: Path to the Certificate Authority file, in PEM format; empty for the system CAs.

ConnectTimeout.description: Timeout for establishing a connection to the server, defaults to 60s. `ConnectTimeout`.

Http2KeepAliveInterval.description: HTTP/2 PING frame interval (e.g. `20s`), defaults to no keepalive.

Http2KeepAliveTimeout.description: HTTP/2 PING timeout (e.g. `10s`), defaults to no timeout.

Http2KeepAliveWhileIdle.description:
Send HTTP/2 keepalive PINGs even when idle, defaults to false.
See `AllowUnsafeConnection` for the accepted spellings.

Http2MaxHeaderListSize.description: HTTP/2 max header list size in bytes, defaults to no limit.

InitialBackOff.description: Wait before the second attempt (e.g. `1s`); empty for the default.

MaxAttempts.description:
Attempts in all for one request, first try included; `1` never replays, `0` is refused, and
empty is the default.

MaxBackOff.description: Ceiling the wait grows to (e.g. `5s`); empty for the default.

OverrideTargetName.description: Override the endpoint name during SSL verification; empty for no override.

PoolIdleTimeout.description:
How long an idle connection is kept in a pool before it is closed. `PoolIdleTimeout`.

Applied by whoever drives the pool: a channel is one connection and has none, so nothing
that builds one reads it.

RateLimit.description:
Rate limit for requests, written `count/duration` (e.g. `100/1s`), defaults to no rate
limit. `RateLimit`.

Applied by whoever builds the channel: this crate declares the option, each HTTP/2 engine
applies it on its side.

TcpKeepalive.description: TCP keepalive duration (e.g. `30s`), defaults to no keepalive.

TcpKeepaliveInterval.description: Interval between TCP keepalive probes (e.g. `5s`), defaults to OS default.

TcpKeepaliveRetries.description: Number of TCP keepalive retries, defaults to OS default.

TcpNagleAlgorithm.description:
Enable Nagle's algorithm (disable TCP_NODELAY), defaults to false. See
`AllowUnsafeConnection` for the accepted spellings.

Timeout.description:
Timeout for each request, defaults to no timeout. `Timeout`.

Applied by whoever builds the channel: this crate declares the option, each HTTP/2 engine
applies it on its side.

UserAgent.description:
User-Agent header value sent with each request. `UserAgent`.

Applied by whoever builds the channel: this crate declares the option, each HTTP/2 engine
applies it on its side.

anyOf.description: A certificate chain and its key bundled together in one PKCS#12 file.

CertP12.description: Path to the PKCS#12 bundle; mutually exclusive with `CertPem`/`KeyPem`.

CertP12Password.description: Password protecting `CertP12`, empty for none; rejected without `CertP12`.

CertPem.description: Path to the certificate chain file, in PEM format; set together with `KeyPem`.

KeyPem.description: Path to the key file, in PEM format; set together with `CertPem`.

anyOf.description: A certificate chain and its key, each in its own PEM file.

CertP12.description: Path to the PKCS#12 bundle; mutually exclusive with `CertPem`/`KeyPem`.

CertP12Password.description: Password protecting `CertP12`, empty for none; rejected without `CertP12`.

CertPem.description: Path to the certificate chain file, in PEM format; set together with `KeyPem`.

KeyPem.description: Path to the key file, in PEM format; set together with `CertPem`.

anyOf.description:
No identity option is required: none of them set, half a PEM pair, or a password naming no
bundle, each of which `load` rejects by name.

CertP12.description: Path to the PKCS#12 bundle; mutually exclusive with `CertPem`/`KeyPem`.

CertP12Password.description: Password protecting `CertP12`, empty for none; rejected without `CertP12`.

CertPem.description: Path to the certificate chain file, in PEM format; set together with `KeyPem`.

KeyPem.description: Path to the key file, in PEM format; set together with `CertPem`.

anyOf.description: A clean URL (or `system`/`none`/empty) next to dedicated credential fields.

ProxyAddress.description:
Where to find the proxy: empty or `system` to follow the environment, `none` for a
direct connection, otherwise the proxy URL, carrying no credentials, whose scheme has
to be `http`.

anyOf.description:
A URL that carries its credentials itself, `user:password@` in its authority; the dedicated
credential fields must stay empty.
